title: Has anyone ever participated in a bicycle race up close to a pool outside of a mall-like area that's bigger on the inside (like the TARDIS)?
content: It's insane how many mallworld dreams I've been remembering lately. All the memories are flooding back all of a sudden. I could go on and on for quite a while describing them, actually. I'm starting to feel like none of this is a coincidence. I had this particular mallworld dream about a year and a half ago. The inside of this mall had practically infinite floors and the exterior was far smaller than the interior. It was amazing. Has anyone been in some kind of bicycle race right next to a pool like what I described in the title?
